Package dev.oumaimaa.kawaiiapi.heads

Class SkullCreator

java.lang.Object
dev.oumaimaa.kawaiiapi.heads.SkullCreator
public final class SkullCreator extends Object
Modern library for creating custom player skulls using Paper's Profile API. Provides non-NMS methods for setting skull textures from UUIDs, URLs, and base64 data.

This implementation is fully compatible with Paper 1.21+ and uses only stable APIs.

Version:
1.0
Author:
KawaiiDevelopment
